attention_runtime_audit.finding: The v1 config has no explicit enable_flash_attn flag, but Wan model.py calls flash_attention directly. flash_attention asserts FlashAttention-2 availability when FlashAttention-3 is absent.
attention_runtime_audit.result: FlashAttention is a runtime requirement for the v1 model path, not an optional performance-only dependency for this protocol.
attention_runtime_audit.next_gate: install and CPU-import official requirements-cu121.txt FlashAttention 2.7.4.post1 under the isolated torch 2.5.1 cu121 stack before model-load smoke
